headline: Tesla Targets Cybercab Robotaxi Sales by End of 2026
summary: Tesla aims to sell Cybercab robotaxis by the end of 2026 as CEO Elon Musk pushes to transform the EV maker into an AI and robotics company.
why: Tesla is a leading electric vehicle manufacturer whose valuation relies heavily on scaling autonomous driving and artificial intelligence initiatives.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Timelines for robotaxis drive investor sentiment regarding Tesla's transition to autonomous services.
